questions.question: Which dates should I plan to travel?
questions.answer: For guests traveling from outside of El Salvador, we recommend arriving on Wednesday, March 10th, and departing on Sunday, March 14th, to enjoy a little extra time in El Salvador. We’ll have optional pre-wedding events beginning Thursday, and there is so much to see and experience throughout the country. We encourage you to take advantage of the opportunity to explore and make a trip out of it!

questions.question: How should I travel around San Salvador?
questions.answer: For getting around San Salvador during your stay, we recommend using hotel-arranged taxis or Uber Black. Private transportation is also available through providers such as Facil Travel and Don Bosco Travel. You can find more details and contact information for private transportation options under the Guest Info – Transportation tab.

questions.question: Where should I stay?
questions.answer: We have room blocks reserved at both the Hyatt and Fairfield for our guests. Both hotels are wonderful options for the wedding weekend, and transportation to and from the wedding will be provided from each location. Airbnb accommodations throughout San Salvador are also a great option for guests who prefer a more independent stay or would like to explore other accommodations in the area.

questions.question: When do I need to RSVP by?
questions.answer:
We'd be grateful to hear from you as early as possible, and kindly ask for all responses by January 16th.

Please RVSP via the RSVP tab on our website.

questions.question: What is the wedding day dress code?
questions.answer:
Time to dress up! We can't wait to see everyone looking their best and celebrating in style. Think suits and ties, tuxedos, floor-length gowns, and all things elegant. Feel free to have fun with your look and dress to impress!

We kindly ask that guests avoid white or anything close to it.

questions.question: What is the lakefront cocktail welcome event attire?
questions.answer: Our welcome cocktail will take place at beautiful Lake Coatepeque, where March weather is typically warm and sunny. The dress code is Lakefront Chic, calling for polished, cocktail-inspired attire with a relaxed lakeside feel. Think linen suits, tailored trousers, elegant dresses, and dressy jumpsuits. We recommend flats, wedges, or block heels, as the terrain can be uneven.

questions.question: What is the weather like?
questions.answer: San Salvador is generally warm year-round. The volcano area can feel cooler in the evening, so we recommend bringing a light jacket or wrap, especially for nighttime events.

questions.question: Who should I contact with travel questions?
questions.answer: The bride and groom would be happy to help with any questions leading up to the wedding! During the wedding weekend, please reach out to our wedding planning team at +(503) 6004-7265 for any assistance or questions that may come up.
